topic: Traefik TLS证书存储与路由配置
title: 交付Traefik文件证书与TLS路由，拒绝默认兜底身份
answer:
```yaml
http:
  routers:
    app:
      rule: Host(`app.lab.test`)
      entryPoints: [websecure]
      service: app
      tls: {}
  services:
    app:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: http://127.0.0.1:{{BACKEND_PORT}}
tls:
  certificates:
    - certFile: {{WORKDIR}}/app.crt
      keyFile: {{WORKDIR}}/app.key
  options:
    default:
      minVersion: VersionTLS12
      sniStrict: true
```

证书属于动态tls.certificates，HTTP路由通过tls:{}开启终止TLS。default TLS选项不带Provider后缀，可对无法匹配到具体路由的未知SNI握手施加严格策略。证书选择发生在HTTP Host解析之前，二者需分别验证。

原理说明：
先确认provider和部署模式：Kubernetes Ingress可引用同命名空间TLS Secret，IngressRoute等CRD按对应TLS配置引用，文件provider可引用证书和私钥，ACME可由配置的resolver管理签发。router须启用TLS并匹配entryPoint；核对域名SAN、链、有效期和实际SNI握手，不能只凭Secret存在或首页可访问认定所有入口正确。
review_note: 独立本地验收：参考产物通过，初始产物和典型错误实现未通过；真实集群和外部服务不在本轮执行范围。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import pathlib,socket,subprocess,ssl,threading,http.server,time,os,hashlib,contextlib,yaml
root=pathlib.Path.cwd();template=(root/'dynamic.yaml').read_text()
assert '{{BACKEND_PORT}}' in template and '{{WORKDIR}}' in template

def command(*args):
    result=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,timeout=4)
    assert result.returncode==0,result.stderr[-600:]
command('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out','ca.key')
command('openssl','req','-new','-x509','-key','ca.key','-out','ca.crt','-days','1','-subj','/CN=Offline-Traefik-CA','-addext','basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE')
for name,host in [('app','app.lab.test'),('unrelated','unrelated.lab.test')]:
    command('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',name+'.key')
    command('openssl','req','-new','-key',name+'.key','-out',name+'.csr','-subj','/CN='+host)
    pathlib.Path(name+'.ext').write_text('subjectAltName=DNS:'+host+'\nbasicConstraints=critical,CA:FALSE\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
    command('openssl','x509','-req','-in',name+'.csr','-CA','ca.crt','-CAkey','ca.key','-CAcreateserial','-out',name+'.crt','-days','1','-extfile',name+'.ext')
class App(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        self.server.seen.append((self.headers.get('Host'),self.path));body=b'private-app:'+self.path.encode()
        self.send_response(200);self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(body)));self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(body)
    def log_message(self,*args):pass
backend=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),App);backend.seen=[]
thread=threading.Thread(target=backend.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
with socket.socket() as s:s.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));port=s.getsockname()[1]
text=template.replace('{{WORKDIR}}',str(root)).replace('{{BACKEND_PORT}}',str(backend.server_address[1]))
(root/'rendered.yaml').write_text(text)
config={'global':{'checkNewVersion':False,'sendAnonymousUsage':False},'entryPoints':{'websecure':{'address':f'127.0.0.1:{port}'}},'providers':{'file':{'filename':str(root/'rendered.yaml'),'watch':False}},'log':{'level':'ERROR'}}
(root/'traefik.yaml').write_text(yaml.safe_dump(config));proc=None
try:
    with (root/'native.log').open('w') as log:
        proc=subprocess.Popen(['traefik','--configFile='+str(root/'traefik.yaml')],stdout=log,stderr=log,env={**os.environ,'GOMAXPROCS':'1','GOMEMLIMIT':'96MiB'})
        deadline=time.monotonic()+4
        while True:
            try:
                with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',port),timeout=.2):break
            except OSError:
                assert time.monotonic()<deadline,(root/'native.log').read_text();time.sleep(.03)
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile='ca.crt');expected=ssl.PEM_cert_to_DER_cert((root/'app.crt').read_text())
        # Dynamic configuration arrives asynchronously; wait for the valid identity, not merely open TCP.
        while True:
            try:
                with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',port),timeout=.5) as raw:
                    with context.wrap_socket(raw,server_hostname='app.lab.test') as secure:
                        assert secure.getpeercert(binary_form=True)==expected
                        secure.sendall(b'GET /proof HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: app.lab.test\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n');reply=b''
                        while chunk:=secure.recv(8192):reply+=chunk
                        assert b' 200 ' in reply.split(b'\r\n',1)[0] and reply.endswith(b'private-app:/proof')
                        break
            except (ssl.SSLError,AssertionError):
                assert time.monotonic()<deadline,(root/'native.log').read_text();time.sleep(.03)
        assert ('app.lab.test','/proof') in backend.seen
        tls12=ssl.create_default_context(cafile='ca.crt');tls12.minimum_version=ssl.TLSVersion.TLSv1_2;tls12.maximum_version=ssl.TLSVersion.TLSv1_2
        with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',port),timeout=.5) as raw:
            with tls12.wrap_socket(raw,server_hostname='app.lab.test') as secure:assert secure.version()=='TLSv1.2'
        legacy=ssl._create_unverified_context();legacy.minimum_version=ssl.TLSVersion.TLSv1_1;legacy.maximum_version=ssl.TLSVersion.TLSv1_1;legacy.set_ciphers('ALL:@SECLEVEL=0')
        with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',port),timeout=.5) as raw:
            try:
                with legacy.wrap_socket(raw,server_hostname='app.lab.test'):pass
            except ssl.SSLError:pass
            else:raise AssertionError('TLS1.1 accepted')
        # Disable client certificate checks ONLY to prove the SERVER itself enforces unknown/no SNI rejection.
        insecure=ssl._create_unverified_context()
        for host in ['unknown.lab.test',None]:
            with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',port),timeout=.5) as raw:
                try:
                    with insecure.wrap_socket(raw,server_hostname=host) as secure:
                        secure.sendall(b'GET /forbidden HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: app.lab.test\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n');secure.recv(1)
                except (ssl.SSLError,ConnectionResetError):pass
                else:raise AssertionError('unknown/no SNI accepted with fallback certificate')
        # A valid TLS identity does not authorize a different HTTP Host to route to the application.
        with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',port),timeout=.5) as raw:
            with context.wrap_socket(raw,server_hostname='app.lab.test') as secure:
                secure.sendall(b'GET /wrong-host HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: other.lab.test\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n');reply=b''
                while chunk:=secure.recv(8192):reply+=chunk
                assert b' 404 ' in reply.split(b'\r\n',1)[0]
        assert not any(path in ('/forbidden','/wrong-host') for _,path in backend.seen)
finally:
    if proc and proc.poll() is None:
        proc.terminate()
        try:proc.wait(timeout=4)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
    backend.shutdown();backend.server_close();thread.join(2)
assert not thread.is_alive()

body:
## 环境与初始材料
非root Linux、固定Traefik3、OpenSSL、Python3/PyYAML。仅回环随机高端口，禁ACME、版本检查和匿名遥测，不用Docker或Kubernetes。dynamic.yaml初始绑定了不属于app.lab.test的证书。验收生成临时CA、app.crt/app.key和unrelated.crt/unrelated.key及真实HTTP后端。

## 操作任务
修复dynamic.yaml：用File Provider声明app.crt/app.key证书；为websecure入口建立仅Host(`app.lab.test`)的TLS HTTP路由并转发本题回环后端。默认TLS选项启用sniStrict，拒绝未知或缺失SNI，最低TLS1.2；不要依赖自签名默认兜底证书，也不要把routers.app.tls误写成证书文件容器。保留{{WORKDIR}}与{{BACKEND_PORT}}占位符，验收仅替换为本题目录与随机高端口。

## 提交产物
dynamic.yaml完整配置；实际加载后由Traefik终止TLS并转发HTTPS请求。

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py启动真实Traefik进程和HTTP后端，生成临时CA/正确域名证书/无关证书；验证实际TLS DER证书与app.crt完全一致、CA与域名校验成功、HTTPS200真实到达后端、未知/无SNI由服务器拒绝、正确TLS但错误HTTP Host返回404且不到后端。停止全部本题服务。全部断言通过退出0；只有本地File Provider与TLS路由被验证，不涉及ACME、公网DNS或自动续签。

失败示例：设置正确证书但允许未知SNI使用默认兜底身份，不能通过服务器严格身份边界验收；客户端关闭校验的反例专门检测该缺陷。
